title: relayConfig
responsibility: Declares operator controls for relay request limits, pairing capacity and device traffic.

configControls.name: relayConfig.bodyBytes
configControls.purpose: Bound accepted request bodies to protect relay memory.

configControls.name: relayConfig.rateWindowMs
configControls.purpose: Choose the time window used to budget public pairing calls.

configControls.name: relayConfig.pairingCalls
configControls.purpose: Set pairing request capacity for expected device traffic.

configControls.name: relayConfig.failedConnects
configControls.purpose: Bound failed connection attempts before rate limiting a host.

configControls.name: relayConfig.openPairings
configControls.purpose: Limit simultaneous pairing offers retained for each host.

configControls.name: relayConfig.frameWindowMs
configControls.purpose: Choose the interval used to budget device frames.

configControls.name: relayConfig.deviceFrames
configControls.purpose: Set device frame capacity for expected interactive traffic.

configControls.name: relayConfig.sweepDelayMs
configControls.purpose: Set how long expired offers remain available to polling devices.
